title: OpenCode pack manifest (contract 1.x)
description: opencode-pack.json at the root of a pack. See contract/CONTRACT.md. `manage-agents pack validate` also checks the rules this schema cannot express (agent IDs, references, layout).

contract.description: Contract version as "MAJOR.MINOR". An unknown major is rejected; a newer minor only warns.

name.description: Global pack identity, used by `requires` and by the resolver.

version.description: Full semver version of the pack.

requires.description: Packs this pack references, mapped to a semver range. "*" is accepted only in local sources.

archetype.description: Declares the pack as a routable archetype: the engine picks each subagent's model from the provider or model its caller runs on.

routingDefaults.description: Suggested routing: trigger ("provider" or "provider/model") -> subagent ID -> "provider/model[#variant]" or "inherit". The user's routing configuration overrides it.
